Messages.Body:
A new version of the archon is available on the  download page : 1.5h

It includes better seatings for 3R+F and 2R+F, as well as many additional seatings for 51+ players (2R+F) or 201+ players (3R+F).

The archons must be used either with Excel or LibreOffice (not OpenOffice).

A synthesis of the optimal seatings per archon can be found here:  2R+F and  3R+F

Prince of Paris, France
